title: Multiple cron expressions route to distinct handlers via the expression-router dispatcher
description: The applying project wires two or more cron expressions to distinct handlers through the dispatcher module. The dispatcher accepts an ordered map of {expression, handler} pairs and, on every scheduled invocation, matches the incoming Cron Trigger event's cron expression against the map. The matched handler receives a bounded context {expression, scheduledTime, sink} and is invoked exactly once. An unmatched expression records a cronUnmatched lifecycle event with metadata-only payload and the scheduled invocation returns without side effect. The dispatcher mode is elicited (single-handler for the trivial single-cron project; expression-routed for multi-cron; recommended default expression-routed when the elicited cron-expressions list has more than one entry) per ADR-3302.
rationale: Ratified in the Cloudflare round 6 spec (2026-09-06 section 5.2). Ships as v1.0.0 of platform-cloudflare-cron-triggers.
